messages.content: Please check the current BTC price and the EUR-to-USD exchange rate, then use my budget currency, EUR, to place a $250 buy order for symbol BTC in my investment account. After that, verify the status of my investment account for user_id user_123. Then find some trending alternative recommendations in the audio category for the Sony XM5 black headphones, product_id p_sony_xm5_blk, and place 1 on hold. Build the invoice for that hold using stripe as the payment gateway and send it to me by email at user@example.com through the email channel. Also retrieve my investment account balance sheet and email that to user@example.com. Finally, create and send me a high-priority post-trade purchase invoice notification by email with priority high.
